chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, those who are sated in this world by intoxicant die thirsty, are resurrected thirsty, and enter the Fire thirsty.

key_terms.عِطَاشًا: thirsty; a repeated description of their punished state
key_terms.يَمُوتُونَ: they die; referring to their state at death
key_terms.يُحْشَرُونَ: they are resurrected/gathered; referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام say about the fate of those who consume intoxicants?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام warns of the severe consequence of consuming intoxicants, portraying their end as marked by thirst at death, resurrection, and entry into the Fire. The hadith emphasizes both the moral gravity of intoxicants and their punishment in the afterlife.
